summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K disclosing its ongoing share repurchase program, approved by shareholders on May 22, 2024. During August 24-25, 2026, the company repurchased 128,904 shares (0.01% of issued capital) on Euronext Paris at a weighted average price of EUR 42.6526, totaling EUR 5,498,096.53. Shares are intended for employee or management share option programs and may be held in treasury. Following the buybacks, the company holds 19,353,812 treasury shares, approximately 2.1% of issued capital. This is a routine buyback disclosure, not a transformative event.
